lead.event: Bank Indonesia cuts reserve requirements and raises the Deposit Facility rate
lead.headline: Bank Indonesia cuts reserve requirements and raises Deposit Facility rate to 5%
lead.blurb: Conventional banks’ reserve requirement falls from 9% to 8% on 1 November and 7% on 1 December, while Islamic banks and business units’ requirement drops from 7.5% to 6.5% and then 5.5%. BI also lowers the KLM incentive from 6% to 5% on 1 December. The 25-basis-point Deposit Facility increase is from 4.75%, while BI holds its policy rate at 5.75% and the Lending Facility at 6.5%. BI says the changes align policy with money-market conditions and are not a signal of liquidity tightening.
lead.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from story to lead

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Indofood, Indofood CBP, and Salim Ivomas plan share buybacks
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: INDF, ICBP and LSIP plan Rp2.25 trillion share buybacks
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Each has allocated up to Rp750 billion, with purchases capped at 20% of paid-in capital and funded from internal cash. The programs are scheduled to run from 26 October to 31 December.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: TOBA secures up to S$555 million investment for Asian waste-management expansion
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: TOBA plans to raise up to S$555 million for Asian waste expansion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Funds managed by HPS Investment Partners would be channeled through SBTH Asia Holdings in staged issuances of preferred shares and warrants, with TOBA retaining control. Shareholder approval is scheduled for 27 November 2026.

earnings_guidance.headline: PGUN reports 33.53% nine-month profit growth
earnings_guidance.blurb: Pradiksi earned Rp135.44 billion for the period ended 30 September, up from Rp101.43 billion a year earlier, while basic earnings per share rose to 23.61 from 17.68. Net sales increased 5.25% to Rp566.1 billion, and PGUN shares rose 3.75% to Rp8,300 in morning trading after the results.

earnings_guidance.headline: BMRI reports nine-month 2026 net profit of Rp45.5 trillion, up 20.7%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bank Mandiri's gross non-performing loan ratio improved to 0.98% from 1.03% a year earlier. Bank-only loans rose 16% to Rp1,605.83 trillion, while third-party funds increased 17.7% to Rp1,750.2 trillion.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 4 new articles with a new fact: Gross non-performing loans improved to 0.98% from 1.03% a year earlier.

earnings_guidance.event: AKR Corporindo reports nine-month 2026 profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: AKRA reports nine-month 2026 profit up 32.37%
earnings_guidance.blurb: AKR Corporindo's revenue rose 43.64% to Rp46.53 trillion, with fuel and basic-chemicals trading and distribution accounting for more than 90%. The segment's gross margin improved to 6.9% in the third quarter from 4.6% in the second quarter, while industrial-estate revenue grew 143.60% to Rp2.72 trillion.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: The trading and distribution segment’s gross margin improved to 6.9% in Q3-2026 from 4.6% in Q2-2026.

earnings_guidance.event: Darma Henwa analyst outlook cites results, growth forecasts, and catalysts
earnings_guidance.headline: DEWA analyst forecasts Rp1.64 trillion net profit in 2027
earnings_guidance.blurb: Darma Henwa plans a Sukuk Wakalah issuance of up to Rp3.5 trillion, with an initial Rp1.5 trillion tranche targeted for December 2026. BRI Danareksa Sekuritas links its outlook to improving results and expansion, forecasting 2027 EBITDA of Rp4.04 trillion, up 86.4%, as DEWA targets 30–35 million bank cubic meters of overburden removal at Sebuku.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 2 new articles with a new fact: DEWA plans a Sukuk Wakalah issuance of up to Rp3.5 trillion.

deals_control.event: PACK plans a rights issue to fund nickel-asset acquisitions
deals_control.headline: PACK plans Rp8.19 trillion rights issue for nickel acquisitions
deals_control.blurb: Abadi Nusantara plans to issue up to 100 billion shares at Rp10, with Eco Energi Perkasa backing up to US$418 million of unsubscribed shares. Proceeds would fund DDL and Bumanik acquisitions, loan repayment and working capital; CNGR targets at least 50% of PACK ahead of the 30 November shareholder vote.
deals_control.copy_decision: rewritten: 2 new articles with a new fact: CNGR is targeting at least 50% ownership of PACK.

deals_control.event: Beruntung Berkat Sejahtera negotiates to acquire control of STRK
deals_control.headline: Beruntung Berkat Sejahtera negotiates to acquire 61.87% of STRK
deals_control.blurb: Beruntung Berkat Sejahtera signed a conditional Indicative Terms and Conditions agreement with Barito Mas Sukses on 21 October. It is negotiating to buy 6.63 billion STRK shares, equal to 61.87% of the company. The proposed acquisition is subject to further due diligence and a definitive sale and purchase agreement, and would make Beruntung Berkat Sejahtera STRK’s controlling shareholder.

deals_control.event: Impack Pratama shareholders buy shares ahead of the interim dividend ex-date
deals_control.headline: IMPC shareholders buy Rp127 billion of shares ahead of interim dividend ex-date
deals_control.blurb: Impack Pratama shareholders bought a combined Rp127 billion of shares. Tunggal Jaya Investama accounted for Rp121.95 billion, buying 150 million shares at Rp813 on 20 October and raising its stake to 38.80% from 38.53%. The company will pay its Rp5-per-share interim dividend on 30 October.
deals_control.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

deals_control.event: Adhi Karya schedules shareholder meeting on divestment and proceeds
deals_control.headline: ADHI schedules 13 November meeting on JMJ divestment and rights issue proceeds
deals_control.blurb: Adhi Karya will seek shareholder approval to divest its holding in affiliate Jasamarga Jogja Solo in a transaction worth more than 50% of its latest audited net assets. It will also seek approval to change the planned use of proceeds from its second rights issue, with the changes valued at more than 10% of total offering proceeds.

market_structure_policy.event: Government plans to hand over Papua gold mine to Antam
market_structure_policy.headline: Government plans to hand over 275.36-hectare Papua gold mine to ANTM
market_structure_policy.blurb: The government revoked Kristalin Eka Lestari’s mining permit on 12 October and shut down its 275.36-hectare site on 22 October. Antam is planned to manage the area as both operator and investor.

macro_flows.event: MSCI's proposed Indonesia reclassification prompts market responses and capital outflows
macro_flows.headline: MSCI proposes Indonesia downgrade as investors sell net US$5.3 billion
macro_flows.blurb: A downgrade would remove all Indonesian stocks from MSCI index coverage, and Goldman Sachs estimates it could trigger US$5.6 billion in outflows. Indonesia has until the end of April 2027 to show progress, with MSCI’s decision expected in June.
macro_flows.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from lead to story
